title: Banana Town — a free pixel town where Banana World begins
description: Walk a free pixel town in your browser: take a job, play the arcade, send letters and meet the neighbours. Banana World starts here.
tag: where Banana World begins: jobs, an arcade, letters and neighbours
note: Walk by tapping or with the arrow keys. Tap a door, sign or resident; the roads lead to the rest of Banana World.
